rationale: Adjudicated as discrepancy_found, matching the packet's effectiveOutcome. The decisive discrepancy is the upstream representation of an incomplete 21-product Toast extraction as a complete catalog, compounded by omitted official menu surfaces and unsupported complete allergen arrays. Terra's central scope and evidence-limit findings are confirmed, while its culinary assumptions, broad PDF conclusion, historical-item characterization, and any cross-contact inference are rejected or narrowed.
